decidedBy: ember (MUD §6.4). These are MUD §2.10's defaults, unchanged; change the numbers here, nothing else reads a copy.
baseSource: MEASURED tariff.base = 3 in M8's run (product/m8-fleet-surface.md:86-87, via p-templates README item 12)

perTopic.note: MUD §2.10: a per-topic base is one more field; all equal to base for v1

createCovers: a room (build room / area load, per cell)

comp.to: every enrolled sheet with alive = 1, on the first K-CLOCK tick of each chain day (clock/day)
comp.by: the realm concierge, PAY §2.8 mechanism 2 (comp payer amount memo), nullifier paycomp:{nonce}
notSpendableOn: Hermes narration (purse-only; the purse refill needs a payer holding at least the minimum refill)
comp.creation: MUD §2.10 says the comp is sized below the creation tariff so a free key creates nothing. With these defaults it is not: daily 1000 > create 500, so a comp-only key can pay for two cells a day. Either create must exceed daily, or creation must be refused on comp-funded credit. This is flagged for ember and not decided here.

observe: 0 (ASSUMED, PLACE A2 / MUD A4: reads carry no fee)
